title: Everyday Phrases — A Surfing Lesson
title_quote: Hi, I want a surfing lesson.
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🏄 實用沖浪課必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — A Surfing Lesson
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用沖浪課情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從報課租板、岸上熱身到第一次站上浪板，不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical A Surfing Lesson phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), from booking the lesson and renting a board, to warm-up drills and catching your first wave. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I want a surfing lesson.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great! A group class or private?
dialogue.zh: 太好了！想上團體課還是私教？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A private one, I am a beginner.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈpraɪvət wʌn, aɪ æm ə bɪˈɡɪnər./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect choice for your first time.
dialogue.zh: 第一次來這樣選最理想。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long does one lesson last?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It lasts about two hours.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much does that cost?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sixty dollars, all included.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the price cover a board?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, board and leash are free.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need my own wetsuit?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We have them in every size.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I try this one first?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, the fitting room is there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This feels a bit tight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wetsuits must fit snug like that.
dialogue.zh: 防寒衣本來就要這麼貼身。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have a rash guard too?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju hæv ə ˈræʃ ɡɑrd tu?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, here is a blue one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔrs, hir ɪz ə blu wʌn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the water cold today?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little, so wear the full suit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈlɪtəl, soʊ wɛr ðə fʊl sut./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who will be my instructor?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is me, my name is Mia.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz mi, maɪ neɪm ɪz ˈmiə./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice to meet you, I am Tom.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs tu mit ju, aɪ æm tɑm./
dialogue.zh: 很高興認識你，我叫湯姆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Welcome, Tom. I will keep you safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɛlkəm, tɑm. aɪ wɪl kip ju seɪf./
dialogue.zh: 歡迎，湯姆。我會保證你的安全。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long have you been surfing?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten years, since I was twelve.
dialogue.zh: 十年了，從我十二歲開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, that is impressive.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You will learn faster than you think.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju wɪl lɜrn ˈfæstər ðæn ju θɪŋk./
dialogue.zh: 你會比想像中學得更快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we start around four?
dialogue.zh: 我們四點左右開始可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four is good. Meet me at the desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔːr ɪz ɡʊd. mit mi æt ðɛ dɛsk./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I bring anything else?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just a towel and water.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to eat before?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but keep it light.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A banana sounds perfect.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great idea. Heavy food makes you sick.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt aɪˈdiə. ˈhɛvi fud meɪks ju sɪk./
dialogue.zh: 好主意。吃太油膩會想吐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do we actually surf?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two miles south, calm beginner waves.
dialogue.zh: 南邊兩英里，浪緩適合新手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So how do we get there?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We will drive there together.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which board should I pick?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take the big soft one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why not a shorter board?
dialogue.zh: 為什麼不選短一點的板？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Big boards float better and feel stable.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪɡ bɔːrdz floʊt ˈbɛtər ænd fil ˈsteɪbəl./
dialogue.zh: 大板的浮力更好也更穩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This leash looks brand new.
dialogue.zh: 這條腳繩看起來是全新的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It keeps your board close to you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt kipz jʊr bɔːrd kloʊs tu ju./
dialogue.zh: 它能讓板一直待在你身邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where exactly does it attach?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Around your back ankle, not the knee.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈraʊnd jʊr bæk ˈæŋkəl, nɑt ðə ni./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you show me the knot?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Watch my hands, then copy me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Like this? Is it tight enough?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly right, you learn fast.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My wax is sticky already.
dialogue.zh: 我的板蠟已經黏黏的了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rub it on the deck in circles.
dialogue.phonetic: /rʌb ɪt ɑn ðə dɛk ɪn ˈsɜrkəlz./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the wax help me grip?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, without it your feet will slide.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, wɪˈðaʊt ɪt jʊr fit wɪl slaɪd./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need sunscreen already?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put it on before we leave.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What factor should I use?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fifty is best for the ocean.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did I miss my nose completely?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Noses burn first, don't worry.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please put some on my ears too.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliːz pʊt sʌm ɑn maɪ ɪrz tu./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done. Ears peel off so easily.
dialogue.zh: 好了。耳朵特別容易脫皮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I wear a hat outside?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only before the water, hats fly off.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli bɪˈfɔːr ðə ˈwɔtər, hæts flai ɔf./
dialogue.zh: 只在下水前戴，帽子會被吹飛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are these surf shoes necessary?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, rocks hide under the sand.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My feet feel safe in them.
dialogue.zh: 穿著它們我的腳很安心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good. Now let's load the boards.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I carry one myself?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold it under your arm, like this.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ɪt ˈʌndər jʊr ɑrm, laɪk ðɪs./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This van smells like salt.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every surf van smells like that.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I keep my phone with me?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ kip maɪ foʊn wɪð mi?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leave it locked in the van.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will you take photos for me?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I shoot every student's ride.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hopefully I look cool out there.
dialogue.zh: 希望到那裡我看起來帥一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everyone looks funny at first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the beach crowded today?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just a few fishermen and two surfers.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ə fju ˈfɪʃmənz ænd tu ˈsɜrfərz./
dialogue.zh: 只有幾個漁夫和兩位衝浪者。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That parking lot is almost full.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We park on the grass instead.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Listen, I can hear the waves already.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɪsən, aɪ kæn hir ðə weɪvz ɔlˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 你聽，我已經聽到浪聲了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Feel the wind, it is offshore today.
dialogue.phonetic: /fil ðə wɪnd, ɪt ɪz ˈɔfˌʃɔr təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 感受一下風，今天是離岸風。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What does offshore wind mean?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It pushes the waves up clean.
dialogue.zh: 它會把浪推得又乾淨又漂亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So today's waves are good?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Better than I ever hoped.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I stretch before we start?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We will warm up on the sand.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi wɪl wɔrm ʌp ɑn ðə sænd./
dialogue.zh: 我們會在沙灘上做熱身。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to sign anything?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just this short safety waiver.
dialogue.zh: 只需籤這張安全免責單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Have you taught many beginners?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hundreds, and most now love it.
dialogue.zh: 教過幾百人了，大部分都愛上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I will love it too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's hope so. Follow me down.
dialogue.zh: 但願如此，跟我往海邊走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The wind smells like freedom.
dialogue.zh: 這風聲裡都是自由的味道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You will love that smell, trust me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju wɪl lʌv ðæt smɛl, trʌst mi./
dialogue.zh: 你會愛上這股味道的，信我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here are our boards on the sand.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɑr ˈaʊər bɔːrdz ɑn ðə sænd./
dialogue.zh: 我們的衝浪板就放在沙灘上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stand behind your board, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Like this, hands on the edges?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, keep it flat and steady.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why must we hold the board?
dialogue.zh: 為什麼一定要扶住板子？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wind can blow it into people.
dialogue.zh: 風會把板子吹到別人身上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I will keep a good grip.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ, aɪ wɪl kip ə ɡʊd ɡrɪp./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good. Now let's warm up first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which muscle should I stretch first?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bend down and touch your toes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Like this? Ouch, my back!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go slow, do not bounce.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I move my hips?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Make slow circles, both directions.
dialogue.zh: 慢慢畫圈，兩個方向都轉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My shoulders feel so tight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Roll them backward ten times.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten rolls done, much better.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your body is ready now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now we practice on the board?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, lie down flat on it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where exactly should I lie?
dialogue.zh: 我具體該趴在哪個位置？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your belly on the middle line.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My toes hang off the back.
dialogue.zh: 我的腳尖露在板尾外面了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slide up until they just touch.
dialogue.zh: 往前挪，到剛好碰到為止。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I look out at the sea?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ lʊk aʊt æt ðə si?/
dialogue.zh: 我該眺望遠處的海面嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look ahead, never at your feet.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why not watch my own feet?
dialogue.zh: 為什麼不能看自己的腳？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Looking down pulls you into the water.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlʊkɪŋ daʊn pʊlz ju ˈɪntu ðə ˈwɔtər./
dialogue.zh: 低頭會把你整個人帶進水裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That makes a lot of sense.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now paddle with flat hands.
dialogue.zh: 現在手掌放平開始劃水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Like swimming on my chest?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, deep and long strokes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My left arm feels weaker.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Balance them, left then right.
dialogue.zh: 兩邊均衡，一下左一下右。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, the board is actually moving!
dialogue.zh: 看，板子真的被我劃動了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes! Keep that strong rhythm.
dialogue.zh: 對！保持這個有力的節奏。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I paddle with closed fists?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Open palms push more water.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many strokes should I do?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten each side, then stop.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twenty done, my arms are on fire.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti dʌn, maɪ ɑrmz ɑr ɑn ˈfaɪər./
dialogue.zh: 二十下完成，手臂像在燃燒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shake them out, then one more set.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃeɪk ðɛm aʊt, ðɛn wʌn mɔːr sɛt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You are a cruel teacher, Mia.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Laughing now, crying in the water.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the hard part, standing up.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We call that move the pop up.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kɔl ðæt muːv ðə pɑp ʌp./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pop up? Like popcorn?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! Same speed, up and done.
dialogue.zh: 哈！就是要爆米花那種速度。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Show me once, very slowly.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Watch my hands and my hips.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hands flat beside my chest?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, like a tiny push up.
dialogue.zh: 對，像一個迷你伏地挺身。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I push my body up?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Push, then bring your knees forward.
dialogue.zh: 撐起，然後把雙膝收到身前。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do both feet land at once?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, one jumps back, one stays front.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, wʌn dʒʌmps bæk, wʌn steɪz frʌnt./
dialogue.zh: 不，一隻跳到最後，一隻留前面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which foot should go forward?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try jumping up on the sand.
dialogue.zh: 先在沙地上跳一次看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My right foot landed behind.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, that is your natural stance.
dialogue.zh: 完美，這就是你的自然站姿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Whoa, I stood up! On sand, but yes!
dialogue.phonetic: /waʊ, aɪ stʊd ʌp! ɑn sænd, bʌt jɛs!/
dialogue.zh: 哇，我站起來了！雖然只是在沙地上！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Beautiful! Now repeat it five times.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Five more? My arms will fall off.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv mɔːr? maɪ ɑrmz wɪl fɔl ɔf./
dialogue.zh: 還五次？我手臂要掉下來啦。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Real surfers pop up one hundred daily.
dialogue.phonetic: /ril ˈsɜrfərz pɑp ʌp wʌn ˈhʌndrəd ˈdeɪli./
dialogue.zh: 真正的衝浪者每天起乘一百次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One hundred! You must be joking.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They really do, muscle memory needs it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ ˈrɪəli du, ˈmʌsəl ˈmɛməri nidz ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 他們真的練，肌肉記憶需要重複。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should my knees stay bent?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, bent knees are your brakes.
dialogue.zh: 要，彎曲的膝蓋就是你的剎車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And my arms out for balance?
dialogue.zh: 手臂張開是為了平衡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like wings, steady and calm.
dialogue.zh: 像翅膀一樣，穩穩地張開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do my eyes go then?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look where you want the board to go.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk wɛr ju wɑnt ðə bɔːrd tu ɡoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 板子想去哪，眼睛就看哪。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So never stare at the shore?
dialogue.zh: 所以不能一直盯著岸邊？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You travel where your eyes travel.
dialogue.zh: 眼睛帶去哪，你就滑去哪。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That rule sounds almost magic.
dialogue.zh: 這條規則聽起來近乎魔法。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try it, board eyes, then pop.
dialogue.zh: 試試看，眼睛看方向，然後起。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I count each try out loud?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ kaʊnt iːtʃ traɪ aʊt laʊd?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, rhythm beats overthinking every time.
dialogue.zh: 要，節奏永遠勝過胡思亂想。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One, two, pop! One, two, pop!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Faster now, the ocean will not wait.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfæstər naʊ, ði ˈoʊʃən wɪl nɑt weɪt./
dialogue.zh: 再快些，大海可不會等你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, I am getting faster already.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I see it, your form is clean.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ si ɪt, jʊr fɔːrm ɪz klin./
dialogue.zh: 我看見了，動作非常乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Am I twisting my hips enough?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Snap them under you, a bit more.
dialogue.phonetic: /snæp ðɛm ˈʌndər ju, ə bɪt mɔːr./
dialogue.zh: 把胯甩到身下，再多一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My board feels lighter now.
dialogue.zh: 現在我感覺板子變輕了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your muscles are learning already.
dialogue.zh: 你的肌肉已經在學習了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if I fall in the water?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf aɪ fɔl ɪn ðə ˈwɔtər?/
dialogue.zh: 如果我掉進水裡怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cover your head with both arms.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I fall flat or roll?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Roll like a log, go deep.
dialogue.zh: 像木頭一樣滾，往深處躲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will my own board hit me?
dialogue.zh: 我自己的板會打到我嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It can, so guard your head always.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt kæn, soʊ ɡɑrd jʊr hɛd ˈɔlˌweɪz./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if I get tired out there?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf aɪ ɡɛt ˈtaɪərd aʊt ðɛr?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rest on your board and float.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How will I hear you out there?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ wɪl aɪ hir ju aʊt ðɛr?/
dialogue.zh: 到了海裡我怎麼聽到你？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I shout, and I use arm signals.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ʃaʊt, ænd aɪ juz ɑrm ˈsɪɡnəlz./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What does a raised arm mean?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Come back to me right away.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And if a huge wave comes?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Grab your board and roll under it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡræb jʊr bɔːrd ænd roʊl ˈʌndər ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 抓穩浪板，連板翻到水下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The water is freezing cold!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Walk in slowly, splash your face.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My legs hate me already.
dialogue.zh: 我的腿已經開始恨我了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep moving, blood will warm you.
dialogue.zh: 別停下，血液循環就暖起來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we walk or paddle out?
dialogue.zh: 我們是走過去還是劃出去？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Walk until your board floats free.
dialogue.zh: 走到板子能漂起來為止。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, now I can start paddling.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stay on your belly, keep going.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A wave just pushed me back!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the sea fights us at first.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðə si faɪts ʌs æt fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 對啊，海一開始都會跟我們較勁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I stand and wait here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, sit down and watch first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do the waves come in groups?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small, small, then one good one.
dialogue.zh: 小的先來兩三個，然後來個好的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which wave should I choose?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take the next gentle rolling one.
dialogue.zh: 挑下一個平緩翻滾的就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I feel it before it breaks?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ fil ɪt bɪˈfɔːr ɪt breɪks?/
dialogue.zh: 浪破之前我感覺得出來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The water lifts you up slowly.
dialogue.zh: 水面會慢慢把你托起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh wait, I feel a small lift now!
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ weɪt, aɪ fil ə smɔːl lɪft naʊ!/
dialogue.zh: 喔等等，我感覺到被輕輕托起來了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then paddle! Paddle like crazy!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Paddling as hard as I can!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep going, feel the board fly.
dialogue.zh: 繼續，感受板子飛起來的那一刻。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pop up now? I think I fell.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɑp ʌp naʊ? aɪ θɪŋk aɪ fɛl./
dialogue.zh: 現在起身嗎？我好像摔了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You fell, but that try was close.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju fɛl, bʌt ðæt traɪ wʌz kloʊs./
dialogue.zh: 是摔了，但這次非常接近。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Salt water straight up my nose!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Blow it out, spit, spit it out.
dialogue.phonetic: /bloʊ ɪt aʊt, spɪt, spɪt ɪt aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 用力呼出去，呸，把水吐出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My eyes are burning so much.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Blink fast, the sea forgives quickly.
dialogue.zh: 快眨眼，大海很快就原諒你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A wave crashed right on my head.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə weɪv kræʃt raɪt ɑn maɪ hɛd./
dialogue.zh: 一道浪整個扣在我頭上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did you stay calm under it?
dialogue.zh: 你在水下保持冷靜了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Like a wet sock, I rolled around.
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪk ə wɛt sɑk, aɪ roʊld əˈraʊnd./
dialogue.zh: 我像隻濕襪子一樣翻來翻去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! Welcome to the washing machine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it this hard for everyone?
dialogue.zh: 大家一開始都這麼難嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The girl beside you fell six times.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ɡɜrl bɪˈsaɪd ju fɛl sɪks taɪmz./
dialogue.zh: 你旁邊那個女生摔了六次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you fall a lot when learning?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju fɔl ə lɑt wɛn ˈlɜrnɪŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 你學的時候也經常摔嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hundreds of times, every single week.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That actually makes me feel better.
dialogue.zh: 這樣說我倒是好受多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Falling is the real teacher here.
dialogue.zh: 摔倒才是這裡真正的老師。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I will try again.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is a champion mindset.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My arms are already so tired.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sit and breathe slowly with me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: In through the nose, out the mouth.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn θru ðə noʊz, aʊt ðə maʊθ./
dialogue.zh: 鼻子吸進去，嘴巴呼出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good. Calm body, calm paddle.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here comes a nice one!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Turn your board, paddle now!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I caught it! I am riding!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pop up! Now! Do not think!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am up! I am actually up!
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm ʌp! aɪ æm ˈæktʃuəli ʌp!/
dialogue.zh: 我起來了！真的站起來了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bend your knees, look ahead!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I did it! Three whole seconds!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Best first wave I ever coached!
dialogue.zh: 這是我帶過最棒的第一浪！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My heart is exploding right now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smile! Today you are a surfer.
dialogue.zh: 笑一個！從今天起你是衝浪者了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Was my balance okay just now?
dialogue.zh: 我剛才的平衡還可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Low, strong, a textbook stance.
dialogue.zh: 重心低、站得穩，教科書級別。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I go for another wave?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, that was only warm up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔːrs, ðæt wʌz ˈoʊnli wɔrm ʌp./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only warm up? I am dying here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli wɔrm ʌp? aɪ æm ˈdaɪɪŋ hir./
dialogue.zh: 只是熱身？我已經快不行了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tired surfers catch the best waves.
dialogue.zh: 累趴的人往往衝得最好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This wave pushed me sideways.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lean the other way to fix it.
dialogue.phonetic: /lin ði ˈʌðər weɪ tə fɪks ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 往另一邊傾斜就能救回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I turn while riding?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press your toes, then your heels.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Heels down turns me left?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It depends on your stance, try both.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt dɪˈpɛndz ɑn jʊr stæns, traɪ boʊθ./
dialogue.zh: 看你的站向，兩邊都試試。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oops, I wiped out in the white foam.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʊps, aɪ waɪpt aʊt ɪn ðə waɪt foʊm./
dialogue.zh: 哎呀，我在白泡沫區翻車了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The foam zone tumbles every beginner.
dialogue.zh: 白浪區每個新手都要翻滾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I got water in my ears.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tilt your head and hop once.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The sun is blinding my eyes.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Turn your back to the sun.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Someone's board spray hit my face.
dialogue.zh: 別人的板濺了我一臉水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep your distance from other surfers.
dialogue.zh: 要跟其他衝浪者保持距離。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who gets the wave first?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The person closest to the wave.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did I block anyone just now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, you stayed in your own zone.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ju steɪd ɪn jʊr oʊn zoʊn./
dialogue.zh: 沒有，你一直在自己的範圍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That foamy wave looks so fun.
dialogue.zh: 那道白浪花看起來好好玩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ride it lying down for now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lying down? Like on the sand?
dialogue.zh: 趴著？像沙灘上練的那樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, catch three waves on your belly.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, kætʃ θri weɪvz ɑn jʊr ˈbɛli./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This feels like riding a sled.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It builds your board feel fastest.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Woohoo! I slid all the way in!
dialogue.phonetic: /wuːˈhu! aɪ slɪd ɔl ðə weɪ ɪn!/
dialogue.zh: 嗚呼！我一路滑回岸邊了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See? The ocean rewards brave hearts.
dialogue.zh: 看到了嗎？大海犒賞勇敢的人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My legs shake from laughing too hard.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ lɛɡz ʃeɪk frʌm ˈlæfɪŋ tu hɑːrd./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That shake means honest work today.
dialogue.zh: 發抖說明今天真的賣力了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The girl next to me cheered for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ɡɜrl nɛkst tə mi tʃɪrd fər mi./
dialogue.zh: 旁邊的女生在為我歡呼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Beginners always cheer for beginners.
dialogue.zh: 新手總是最懂新手的快樂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we clap when someone stands?
dialogue.zh: 別人站起來時該鼓掌嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, surfers shout to celebrate.
dialogue.zh: 要，衝浪的人會大喊慶祝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I try standing once more?
dialogue.zh: 我能再試一次站起來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if your arms agree to it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ɪf jʊr ɑrmz əˈɡri tu ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 先問問你的手臂答不答應。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My arms say yes, barely.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then position, watch, wait, breathe.
dialogue.zh: 那就選位、觀察、等待、呼吸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A perfect one is coming!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Paddle, paddle, paddle... now pop!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Up again! My feet stayed this time!
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌp əˈɡɛn! maɪ fit steɪd ðɪs taɪm!/
dialogue.zh: 又站起來了！這次雙腳沒滑！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five seconds, maybe six. Amazing!
dialogue.zh: 五秒，也許六秒，太厲害了！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can feel the rhythm now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You read the waves like a local.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju rid ðə weɪvz laɪk ə ˈloʊkəl./
dialogue.zh: 你讀浪的樣子像本地人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A local who still falls a lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈloʊkəl hu stɪl fɔlz ə lɑt./
dialogue.zh: 一個還是老摔倒的本地人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Locals fall more than tourists think.
dialogue.zh: 本地人摔得比遊客想像的還多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My last wave felt really smooth.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That was your best ride today.
dialogue.zh: 那是你今天最漂亮的一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many waves did I catch?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eight, with two clean stand ups.
dialogue.zh: 八個，其中兩次起乘很乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eight! That number makes me happy.
dialogue.zh: 八個！這個數字讓我好開心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most beginners only catch three.
dialogue.zh: 多數新手只能抓到三個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is our time up already?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten more minutes, then we finish.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am not ready to stop yet.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm nɑt ˈrɛdi tə stɑp jɛt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Save that fire for tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will I be sore tomorrow?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Very sore. Welcome to surfing.
dialogue.zh: 會很酸，歡迎來到衝浪的世界。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which parts will hurt the most?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shoulders, back, and both thighs.
dialogue.zh: 肩膀、後背，還有兩條大腿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tonight, the couch is my home.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stretch before bed, you will thank me.
dialogue.phonetic: /strɛtʃ bɪˈfɔːr bɛd, ju wɪl θæŋk mi./
dialogue.zh: 睡前拉伸一下，你會謝我的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we ride one final wave?
dialogue.zh: 我們還能衝最後一道浪嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, here comes our last good one.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, hɪr kʌməz ˈaʊər læst ɡʊd wʌn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I turned on the wave! Did you see?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ tɜːrnd ɑn ðə weɪv! dɪd ju si?/
dialogue.zh: 我在浪上轉彎了！看到了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I saw it! I was filming it!
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ sɔ ɪt! aɪ wəz ˈfɪlmɪŋ ɪt!/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You filmed my best moments?
dialogue.zh: 你拍下了我最好的瞬間？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And your funniest wipeouts too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Delete the wipeout clips, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Never. Those are my favorites.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did I fall on my leash again?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd aɪ fɔl ɑn maɪ liːʃ əˈɡɛn?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Once, but you recovered fast.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Time to head back to shore?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, walk your board in gently.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Walking out feels easier now.
dialogue.zh: 現在走出去感覺輕鬆多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your body learned the water today.
dialogue.zh: 你的身體今天認識了大海。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The sunset is painting the waves.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sunset surf is the best medicine.
dialogue.zh: 黃昏衝浪是最好的良藥。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's rinse the salt off the boards.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts rɪns ðə sɔlt ɔf ðə bɔːrdz./
dialogue.zh: 我們把板上的鹽沖掉吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use this fresh water hose here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should the wax come off too?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, wax stays until summer.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I return the leash?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hang it on the numbered hook.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the wetsuit goes in here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rinse it first, then hang it up.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪns ɪt fɜːrst, ðɛn hæŋ ɪt ʌp./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mine came out a bit crooked.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Crooked is fine, it dries anyway.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I keep checking the board for dings.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kip ˈtʃɛkɪŋ ðə bɔːrd fər dɪŋz./
dialogue.zh: 我不停檢查板子有沒有磕破。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No dings, you treated it gently.
dialogue.zh: 沒有破損，你待它很溫柔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My nose is redder than a tomato.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ noʊz ɪz ˈrɛdər ðæn ə təˈmeɪtoʊ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You missed a spot near your eyebrow.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju mɪst ə spɑt nɪr jʊr ˈɛrˌbaʊ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See? Sunburn always finds a way.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cool it tonight with wet towels.
dialogue.zh: 今晚用濕毛巾給它降溫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Aloe gel helps, my mom taught me.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈloʊ dʒɛl hɛlps, maɪ mɑm tɔt mi./
dialogue.zh: 蘆薈膠有用，我媽教我的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep the gel in your bag, always.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ðə dʒɛl ɪn jʊr bæɡ, ˈɔlˌweɪz./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My shoulders can barely lift the bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈʃoʊldərz kæn ˈbɛrli lɪft ðə bæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 我肩膀連包都快提不動了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will carry it, you did well today.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl ˈkæri ɪt, ju dɪd wɛl təˈdeɪ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I pay for the next lesson now?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ peɪ fər ðə nɛkst ˈlɛsən naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 我能現在付下一節課的錢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, cash or card?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Card, please. Same time tomorrow?
dialogue.zh: 刷卡。明天同一時間好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring the same shoes and socks.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I get the same foam board?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ ɡɛt ðə seɪm foʊm bɔːrd?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, until your stand up is automatic.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ənˈtɪl jʊr stænd ʌp ɪz ˌɔːtəˈmætɪk./
dialogue.zh: 對，直到你起乘變成自動的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long until I ride real waves?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ ənˈtɪl aɪ raɪd ril weɪvz?/
dialogue.zh: 我要多久才能衝真正的浪？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A few weeks of practice, honestly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Weeks? I hoped for tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Surfing cannot be rushed, my friend.
dialogue.zh: 衝浪這件事急不來的，朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I practice pop ups at home?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ ˈpræktɪs pɑp ʌps æt hoʊm?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, on your bedroom floor nightly.
dialogue.zh: 能，每天在臥室地板上練。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My floor is harder than sand.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put a yoga mat under yourself.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will my neighbors hate the thumping?
dialogue.zh: 鄰居會討厭我的咚咚聲嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do it before ten, they will forgive.
dialogue.phonetic: /du ɪt bɪˈfɔːr tɛn, ðeɪ wɪl fərˈɡɪv./
dialogue.zh: 十點前練，他們會原諒你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Everyone will see these photos tonight.
dialogue.zh: 今晚我要讓所有人看到這些照片。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Send me one where I look graceful.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛnd mi wʌn wɛr aɪ lʊk ˈɡresfəl./
dialogue.zh: 也發我一張看起來優雅的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You were in every photo already.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, I am now part of your story.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd, aɪ æm naʊ pɑːrt ʌv jʊr ˈstɔːri./
dialogue.zh: 好，我就是你故事的一部分了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What do you eat after surfing?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Big fries and a fish sandwich.
dialogue.zh: 一大份薯條加魚肉三明治。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is a shack by the pier.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə ʃæk baɪ ðə pɪr./
dialogue.zh: 棧橋邊就有一間小食攤。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is exactly our spot tonight.
dialogue.zh: 那正是我們今晚的據點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My treat, you earned every fry.
dialogue.zh: 我請客，每根薯條你都值得。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I will order the largest one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ wɪl ˈɔːrdər ðə ˈlɑːrdʒəst wʌn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do surfers really eat this much?
dialogue.zh: 衝浪的人真的都吃這麼多嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The ocean eats your energy first.
dialogue.zh: 是大海先吃掉了你的體力。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did I really stand up today?
dialogue.zh: 我今天真的站起來過嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twice, and video does not lie.
dialogue.zh: 兩次，而且影片不會說謊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Play the video one more time.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look, that smile is brand new.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I walked in scared at first.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now you do not want to leave.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ju du nɑt wɑnt tə liv./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You know me far too well.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is an instructor's superpower.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See you tomorrow at four, then?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Booked. I saved you the sunset slot.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʊkt. aɪ seɪvd ju ðə ˈsʌnˌsɛt slɑt./
dialogue.zh: 約好了，我給你留了黃昏場。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sunset waves tomorrow? Perfect plan.
dialogue.zh: 明天黃昏衝浪？完美的計劃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rest now, drink water, stretch gently.
dialogue.zh: 現在去休息、喝水、輕輕拉伸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you, Mia. Best day ever.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你，米婭。最棒的一天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank the ocean, it chose you today.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ði ˈoʊʃən, ɪt tʃoz ju təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 謝大海吧，是它今天選了你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will wave at every surfer now.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl weɪv æt ˈɛvəri ˈsɜrfər naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 以後見到衝浪的人我都打招呼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Welcome to the club, Tom. Rest well.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɛlkəm tə ðə klʌb, tɑm. rɛst wɛl./
dialogue.zh: 歡迎加入大家庭，湯姆。好好休息。
